# fluss-go v0.1.0-beta.5

This prerelease improves production readiness for Apache Fluss 0.9.1 clients
with bounded scheduling, streaming remote reads, optional official SDK
adapters, and stricter transport cancellation isolation.

## Highlights

- Adds bounded, opt-in idempotent retries for log and KV writers while
  preserving writer IDs, batch sequences, and encoded request bytes.
- Batches compatible point and prefix lookups across concurrent calls with
  explicit queue, delay, request-size, concurrency, timeout, and retry bounds.
- Streams exact remote-file ranges and prefetches remote log and snapshot data
  within concurrent object and byte budgets.
- Adds an optional S3 adapter using the official AWS SDK for Go v2.
- Adds an optional OpenTelemetry adapter using the stable official metrics API.
- Adds KV snapshot lease renewal to `fadm`.
- Prevents request cancellation from poisoning a managed connection and
  replaces connections interrupted after a partial frame write.
- Makes the live Apache Fluss 0.9.1 integration workflow a required
  pull-request gate.

## Upgrade notes

- Writer retries still default to one attempt. Enable bounded idempotent
  retries explicitly with `WithLogRetryPolicy` or `WithKVRetryPolicy`; more
  than one attempt requires all-replica acknowledgements.
- Lookup clients now use a bounded scheduler. Tune `WithLookupBatch`,
  `WithLookupQueue`, `WithLookupTimeout`, and `WithLookupRetryPolicy` for the
  application's latency and queue budget.
- Existing `RemoteFileReader` implementations remain supported. Implement
  `RemoteFileStreamReader.OpenRemoteFile` to avoid complete-object buffering
  and participate in bounded range prefetch.
- Plain local filesystem paths must be absolute. Use an absolute path or a
  local `file://` URI.
- Importing `adapters/s3` or `adapters/otel` adds its official upstream API
  dependencies. Core `pkg/fgo` remains storage-SDK and telemetry-SDK neutral.

See the [full changelog](../../CHANGELOG.md), the
[write scheduling guide](../../docs/write-scheduling.md), the
[lookup scheduling guide](../../docs/lookup-scheduling.md), the
[remote-storage guide](../../docs/remote-storage.md), and the
[observability guide](../../docs/observability.md).

This is a pre-v1 release. Pin the version and review the changelog before
upgrading.
